notes.kind: a laser-guided bomb: the shared laser path (docs/weapons.md §9.8), guided onto the targeting pod's laser spot when the laser fires, else to the bomb's CCIP point
notes.drag: carriage drag index (10^4 x the drag coefficient on the F-16's 300 sq ft wing, flight-model.md §9.18): 0.25 x its 0.360 m across (w-gbu16) frontal area, 0.25 the drag of a body with a guidance kit (canards, the wing kit) on its pylon on that area (inferred, as the JDAMs')

notes.power: the MK-83's (our damage scale): the same bomb body
notes.model: our MK-83 with the Paveway II's guidance and tail kits (shared/extra/models/stores/mk83lb.glb)
notes.generation: ours: the weapons.ibx section key (generation · 1000 + type) is one per weapon of a kind
notes.carried: the F-16I carries the GBU-10, GBU-12 and GBU-16 (sufa-at)
